_how_to: Written by the in-game bg editor (--bgeditor --sandbox). Each entry is a pixel offset ADDED to the piece's authored position in rebuild/scripts/main.gd — dx right, dy DOWN. Optional "deleted": true hides the piece (and the riders that copy its paint) at every boot; remove the key to bring it back. Optional top-level "clones" spawns copies: {"source": <piece>, "dx": n, "dy": n} — the copy seats at the source's authored position + dx/dy and is itself editable/deletable. Delete this file (or zero the values) to restore the shipped seats. Guide: work/tmp_final14/BG_EDITOR_HOWTO.md.
